items.title: Strengthening our partnership with the UK government to support prosperity and security in the AI era
items.summary: Deepening our partnership with the UK government to support prosperity and security in the AI era
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind与英国政府深化合作，旨在通过AI加速科学发现与公共服务现代化。合作重点包括向英国科学家提供“AI for Science”模型访问权限，涵盖AlphaEvolve（编码智能体）、AlphaGenome（基因组模型）及多智能体协作系统等，旨在解决科学研究中的复杂挑战。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了前沿AI模型在科学研究与公共服务领域的政府级合作模式。

items.title: Strengthening cyber resilience as AI capabilities advance
items.summary: OpenAI is investing in stronger safeguards and defensive capabilities as AI models become more powerful in cybersecurity. We explain how we assess risk, limit misuse, and work with the security community to strengthen cyber resilience.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布关于提升网络安全韧性的说明，强调随着AI能力的增强，公司正加大对安全防护与防御性能力的投入。文章阐述了OpenAI如何评估模型风险、限制滥用，并与安全社区合作，以应对AI技术在网络安全领域带来的双刃剑效应。

aiReview.reasonZh: 探讨了AI模型在网络安全领域的防御能力建设，具有重要的行业参考价值。
